transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you into the clinic today?

Thank you. Well, what brought me in is... I'm just so worn out. It's gotten to the point where even walking from the bedroom to the kitchen feels like I've been hauling lumber all day. And the thing is, resting doesn't help. Sitting down, lying in bed... it just doesn't give me anything back.
Aside from feeling physically exhausted, how has your mood been lately?

It's been pretty bad. Honestly, I wake up with this heavy, hopeless feeling right in my chest. And some days... I just go sit out in the garage and cry. I don't even know what started it, to be honest. It just hits me.
How long have you been feeling this low and exhausted?

It's been about four months now. I think it really started when my wife went back to working full-time. Since then, I've just been spending most of the weekdays alone at the house, and... yeah, that's about when all this started.
Have you ever had a period in your life before this where you felt this low or exhausted for weeks at a time?
No, not really. I mean, I've had times in my life where I was stressed or tired, but... nothing like this. This is the first time I've ever felt this low, or had it last anywhere near this long.
Have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in activities you normally enjoy?

Yeah, very much so. I used to really look forward to things... going to choir, playing pickup ball, or just working on cars. I always liked grilling for the family, too. But now, I just can't make myself care about any of it. I don't care enough to show up, and honestly, I don't even answer people's texts when they check in on me. I just don't have the interest anymore.
How has your sleep been over these past four months?

I haven't really noticed any major changes with it, to be honest. I guess I'm sleeping about the same as I always have. I'm just exhausted all day regardless... but as far as the actual sleep goes at night, I'm not really sure. It seems fine, I haven't really paid much attention to it.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite lately?

No, not really. I think I'm eating about the same amount I usually do. I haven't lost any weight or gained any, as far as I know. Food just... it is what it is. I'm not really paying attention to it, but my appetite hasn't really changed.
Have you found it difficult to concentrate or focus on things recently?

No, I haven't really noticed any issues with that. I mean, I can still focus on things when I need to, I guess. I just don't have the energy to do much, so I'm not really trying to concentrate on a whole lot right now. But when I do, it seems okay.
Have you been having feelings of worthlessness, or feeling like you are letting others down or blaming yourself for things?

Yeah, I have. I keep thinking about how I've failed my wife, and my kids... my church, too. It just feels like every bad thing that's happening around us right now is somehow a punishment. Like I'm being punished for not being the man I was supposed to be.
With everything feeling so heavy, have you had any thoughts that life isn't worth living, or thought about hurting yourself?
Yeah, I have. The thought just... it keeps coming back that I should just be dead. And when I'm alone, it really scares me, because I start thinking I might actually do something to make that happen.
Have you ever had a time in your life when you felt the opposite of this—unusually high, full of energy, or needing very little sleep?

No... no, I haven't. I don't think I've ever felt like that. I've always just been pretty normal, I guess, before all this started. I've definitely never had a time where I was full of energy or didn't need to sleep.
